Title: Credit Risk Models & Governance - Data Scientist Jr. (Ciudad de México, Cuauhtémoc).
Description: ¿Qué estamos buscando? Buscamos un/a Credit Risk Models & Governance - Data Scientist para integrarse al equipo de Riesgos y Analítica Avanzada. La posición tiene como objetivo principal liderar el ciclo de vida integral de los modelos cuantitativos de riesgo de crédito: desde el diseño, desarrollo e implementación mediante técnicas avanzadas de machine learning y procesamiento en la nube, hasta su monitoreo continuo, validación estadística y aseguramiento del marco de gobernanza ( Model Governance ) y cumplimiento normativo. Principales responsabilidades Diseñar, desarrollar e implementar modelos predictivos de riesgo de crédito (credit scoring, ratings, reservas, capital, ingresos y alertas tempranas) utilizando algoritmos de aprendizaje automático ( machine learning ) e inteligencia artificial. Procesar, depurar y analizar grandes volúmenes de datos (en AWS y entornos locales), garantizando la calidad, consistencia y robustez de las bases de datos para desarrollo y seguimiento. Ejecutar el monitoreo continuo y las pruebas estadísticas de desempeño para evaluar la efectividad, estabilidad y calibración de los modelos y parámetros de riesgo de crédito. Proponer y justificar las métricas, umbrales y triggers de seguimiento más adecuados para aquellas tipologías de modelos que no cuenten con alertas previamente definidas. Documentar rigurosamente los análisis de desempeño, metodologías y excepciones al seguimiento, aportando evidencia estadística ante comités internos, áreas de control, evaluación y entidades regulatorias. Comunicar de manera efectiva a los líderes de negocio e interesados clave los impactos metodológicos, cuantitativos y las debilidades identificadas, impulsando planes de acción para mitigar el riesgo de modelo. Retos del puesto Liderar con autonomía y solvencia técnica el ciclo analítico integral de los modelos de riesgo de crédito en un entorno dinámico de analítica avanzada; logrando no solo diseñar algoritmos de alta capacidad predictiva, sino también garantizar un monitoreo oportuno y consistente que traduzca las evidencias estadísticas en acciones preventivas reales, asegurando el cumplimiento estricto del gobierno de modelos ante los comités y las entidades reguladoras. Los requisitos que debes cumplir son los siguientes: Conocimientos deseables Manejo y explotación de bases de datos mediante SQL (queries complejas, cruces y joins). Experiencia en procesamiento en la nube (Amazon Web Services - AWS). Conocimiento previo del sector bancario o financiero. Nivel de inglés técnico (lectura y comprensión). Conocimientos obligatorios Dominio técnico intermedio en Python, SAS o PySpark. Sólidos fundamentos en estadística, probabilidad, matemáticas y algoritmos de machine learning . Experiencia en diseño, depuración, preparación y análisis de grandes volúmenes de datos. Conocimiento en metodologías y parámetros de Riesgo de Crédito, así como en marcos de gobierno y validación de modelos ( Model Governance ). Escolaridad Licenciatura concluida en Actuaría, Matemáticas, Matemáticas Aplicadas, Ciencia de Datos, Física o carreras afines. Experiencia Experiencia de 1 a 2 años en desarrollo, validación o seguimiento/monitoreo de modelos predictivos de riesgo de crédito o analítica avanzada. Competencias : Decisiones basadas en datos Somos un solo equipo Compromiso con las responsabilidades Foco en la ejecución Si te encuentras interesado/a, postúlate dando clic en “Solicitar”. No olvides adjuntar tu CV actualizado.

Title: Delivery Engineer, ML, Americas
Description: About Hilbert Hilbert is a scalable, data science-first growth engine that gives B2C teams predictive clarity into user behavior, revenue drivers, and the actions that drive sustainable growth. Fully agentic by design, Hilbert shrinks months-long decision cycles to minutes. From Fortune 10 enterprises to beloved brands like FreshDirect, Blank Street, and Levain Bakery, operators run their growth on Hilbert. We're also co-building alongside leading AI companies. The Mission: Turn Ground Truth Into Growth Hilbert has two parts: a data foundation that gives our AI agents a high-fidelity view of each business, and an agentic web app where growth teams find and act on insights. The scores and audiences you build feed both: our agents reason with them, and our activation sends them into paid media and CRM. The hard problem Every customer's data is different, their compute may be ClickHouse, Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery, and their teams want proof, not promises. Your models have to work in that environment and show measured uplift. We want every pod to stay lean and efficient across very different customer environments, delivering quality work at startup speed. You focus on delivery; our sales engineers handle pre-sales. Your work centers on customers in your own region: supporting customers elsewhere is a rare exception, and your global work is mainly staying aligned with Hilbert colleagues in other regions. What You'll Do Feature stores: build customer-specific, point-in-time correct features on the data foundation. Models: train, tune and validate propensity, churn, lifetime value, uplift and custom models, starting from our ML templates and building custom models when a customer needs something the templates don't cover. New model types that many customers will need are built first by our product engineering team, and you roll them out to later customers. Model analysis: go beyond aggregate metrics to verify what each model has learned, what drives its scores, and how it behaves across segments and on edge cases. Deployment: models run in the customer's own environment or on our managed stack. In either case, understand the constraints, pin down the requirements, design the ML system to fit, and write the scores and audiences our agents and activation use. Measurement: own the statistical design inside our growth team's measurement plan, from power and holdout setup to uplift analysis. Trust: document models for the customer's data science and risk teams, then monitor and retrain them in production. Productization: turn repeated features and model patterns into product with our product engineering team. What Success Looks Like Audiences built from your models lift the agreed growth metric, such as conversion or retention, against a holdout group, and that result decides whether the customer takes them to production. Who You Are The translator: you explain a model to a customer's data science team and earn their trust. The experimenter: you'd rather prove uplift in a holdout test than show off an offline metric. The pilot: you get the most out of AI agents across model iterations, from feature ideas and experiment runs to error analysis, and help build them into how the team works. The systems thinker: you build reusable features, pipelines and automation instead of one-off models, so a small team can deliver across very different environments. Extensive applied ML experience on tabular customer data, with strong Python and ML libraries. Extensive hands-on deep learning experience, from designing architectures and loss functions to training and shipping models in production, with PyTorch or a similar framework. Feature engineering in SQL warehouses such as Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery. Working data engineering experience: building and debugging pipelines, data orchestration, data modeling and data quality checks, enough to own your feature pipelines end to end with our data engineers. Production ML with tools such as MLflow, Weights & Biases or Vertex AI. Solid experiment design and uplift measurement. Comfortable working in a distributed team across time zones. Fluent Spanish for roles based in Latin America. Nice to have DevOps, software architecture and security knowledge Growth-focused data projects experience Industry experience such as e-commerce, retail, fintech, telco and media Model governance in regulated industries such as banking and telco: model documentation, explainability and PII handling Able to travel to the US when necessary Reporting and location You report to your pod's Lead Delivery Engineer and work alongside our data delivery engineers and product engineering team. The role is based in Americas. Delivery runs remotely, with occasional visits to our largest customers. Why join us At Hilbert, we move fast, work collaboratively, and give people real ownership over their impact. As a fast-growing company, there's no shortage of room to grow — you'll take on new challenges quickly and shape the path as you go. Hilbert is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive culture, and we welcome applicants of all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Title: Lead Product Data Analyst
Description: About LawnStarter LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, with over $150M in annual bookings and two consecutive years of profitability. We're expanding beyond lawn care to become the one-stop shop for all home services, and we're investing in the next generation of our platform to get there. About The Team We're a high-leverage team of Product Data Analysts embedded across the business, owning the semantic layer and the metrics everyone trusts. We turn "I have a hunch" into "here's what actually happened," and we're the reason teams across the company can make calls on evidence instead of instinct. This role brings dedicated analytical firepower to the Pro (supply) side of that work. Requirements The Role As a Lead Product Data Analyst, you'll directly impact our results through insights and reports. You'll work closely with product managers, researchers, and other business stakeholders, helping with prioritization, assessments, and business recommendations. Alongside the rest of the Analytics team, it's your responsibility to nurture the data-driven culture within the company, making data easier to consume, whether through interactive reports, easy-to-use datasets, documentation, or training. You'll work with the autonomy of a Lead: setting your own standards, working independently, and acting as a trusted thought partner rather than an order-taker. That title isn't about managing people, there's no team attached to it. It's about the bar you hold your own analysis to, and the bar you help everyone around you reach. This role leans toward the Pro (supply) side of our marketplace, though the exact focus flexes with where the business needs the most insight. What You'll Own Modeling & Analysis: A marketplace is a complex system, with many moving parts and often contradicting signals. That creates an exciting pool of opportunities to find gaps, insights, and optimizations. Analyses range from a simple A/B test to a multivariate model on retention or ETA, backed by advanced SQL and intermediate Python or R Reporting: A complex system produces a high number of metrics worth tracking. A dashboard is only as good as our trust that it's correct and current. You'll understand the needs of the teams you work with and help create and maintain the reporting system, keeping it organized and easy to act on Analytics Engineering: Occasionally you'll work in the inner layers of the Data Warehouse to provide clean, documented datasets that power our reports and end users. We use dbt for transformation, so SQL is a must Problems to Solve Metrics nobody fully trusts. Different teams cite different numbers for the same thing, and no one's quite sure which is current. Untangling that and giving the business one number it can stand behind is core to the job. Analysis that ships but doesn't move anything. A technically correct answer that doesn't change a single decision is still a failure. Getting a stakeholder to actually act on what you found is the hard part, not the SQL. Data that's hard for anyone but an analyst to touch. If every question requires filing a ticket and waiting on you, you haven't built a data-driven culture, you've built a bottleneck. A system with too many moving parts and not enough signal. Supply, demand, pricing, and service quality all interact. Teasing out what's actually driving a metric versus what's noise is a real analytical problem, not a formality. What Success Looks Like (Year 1) The metrics teams rely on daily are trusted, documented, and current, no one's quietly keeping a shadow spreadsheet because they don't trust the dashboard Routine questions are self-serve: stakeholders find their own answers in existing reports instead of pinging you for a one-off pull You can name specific decisions your analysis changed, not just analyses you delivered The datasets and models you've built in dbt are clean and documented enough that other analysts build on them without redoing your work Who You Are AI-Native: You use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, and similar) daily to move faster: drafting and debugging SQL and dbt models, scripting analysis, and shaping reports, and you keep experimenting with new capabilities as they show up. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you're skeptical of AI tools or prefer to do everything by hand. Learning Mindset: You take pride in understanding problems deeply and asking the right questions before reaching for an answer. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you have a preconceived system of processes and methods and plan on just applying them without first learning all the ways our business is unique. Sets the Bar: As a Lead, you work autonomously, hold your own analysis to a high standard, and raise the bar for the people around you, whether or not they report to you. Product managers and stakeholders should see you as a trusted thought partner, not an order-taker. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you want a title and a team before you're willing to raise everyone else's standards. Team Player: You are ready to work alongside exceptional people, helping them achieve great results. You create an environment where people are excited to work with you daily, with intellectual honesty and trust. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you value being right over reaching the right answer together. Business Focus: You care deeply about understanding business needs and how your analysis connects with our product, customers, and financials. You can envision how metrics drill down from the highest to the lowest level, identifying what needs to be analyzed or reported on at each. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you're happiest doing analysis for its own sake, disconnected from a decision it will drive. Bias for Action: You understand that despite your careful approach to understanding problems, you actively avoid being a perfectionist or getting tied up in knots. You have a bias for action to make progress, and you enjoy being scrappy, with constraints that enthrall you. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you, by default, like building full solutions from the get-go. This Role Is NOT A ticket queue. You're not here to pull numbers on demand, you decide what's worth measuring and how to measure it A dashboard-admin seat. Maintaining BI tooling is part of the job, not the point of it. The point is the insight the dashboard delivers A people-management role. This is an individual-contributor seat. "Lead" describes the bar you hold yourself and others to, not a team you manage A role that waits for perfectly clean data. If you need data handed to you pre-cleaned before you can start, this isn't the right seat, you're expected to get your hands into the warehouse Tools of the Trade SQL and dbt for transformation and modeling, Python or R for the occasional statistical deep dive, and Lightdash as our primary BI layer for dashboards and self-serve reporting. Benefits Base salary: $75,000-$100,000 USD annually AI tooling provided: The Claude routines already running pieces of our experimentation process are yours to extend, not a side project you have to justify Fully remote: This is deep-focus analytical work with US-facing partners. We hire the best analyst regardless of city and trust you to manage your environment and overlap hours Flexible PTO: Measured on outcomes, not hours logged VERY IMPORTANT REMINDER: Please upload your English resume. Applications without it will not be considered.

Title: Business Analyst
Description: Analista de Riesgos | Bravo México Estamos buscando a nuestro próximo Analista de Riesgos para unirse al equipo de Bravo. Si te apasiona el análisis de INFORMACION, la mejora de procesos y resolver problemas complejos, este reto es para ti. Serás un jugador clave en la operación, analizando información financiera y de clientes, identificando riesgos y tendencias, y convirtiendo datos en decisiones que impacten directamente el crecimiento del negocio. ¿Qué harás? Analizar información financiera, operativa y de clientes para identificar riesgos, oportunidades, tendencias y patrones de comportamiento que puedan impactar el negocio. Monitorear indicadores clave y dar seguimiento a ajustes, desviaciones y controles para asegurar una operación eficiente y sostenible. Participar en el diseño, análisis y evaluación de estrategias de crédito mediante modelos analíticos, experimentación y análisis de resultados. Identificar oportunidades de mejora y proponer estrategias que permitan optimizar procesos y fortalecer la operación. Evaluar el equilibrio entre crecimiento, rentabilidad y riesgo para contribuir a una mejor toma de decisiones. Detectar anomalías y comportamientos atípicos, anticipando posibles riesgos y generando acciones para mitigarlos. Automatizar reportes y análisis para reducir procesos manuales y generar información confiable, oportuna y accionable. Trabajar de manera cercana con diferentes áreas para convertir el análisis en soluciones y proyectos de impacto para el negocio. Encajas en el perfil si: Tienes pensamiento analítico Sabes recopilar, analizar e interpretar información, encontrar patrones y convertir datos en conclusiones claras. Piensas estratégicamente No te quedas con el “qué pasó”; buscas entender el “por qué” y proponer qué deberíamos hacer después. Eres resolutivo Te gusta enfrentarte a problemas complejos, estructurarlos y encontrar soluciones basadas en información. Sabes gestionar proyectos Eres organizado, puedes trabajar con diferentes prioridades y llevar una iniciativa de principio a fin. Trabajas bien en equipo Puedes colaborar con diferentes áreas, comunicar tus ideas y generar influencia para llevarlas a la ejecución. Estás orientado a resultados Te interesa medir el impacto de lo que haces y buscar constantemente formas de mejorar la operación. ¿Qué necesitas? Licenciatura concluida Ingeniería, Economía, Finanzas, Actuaría, Matemáticas o carreras afines . Al menos dos años de experiencia previa en Banca, Fintech, o Afin Sólida capacidad analítica y gusto por las matemáticas. Conocimientos de bases de datos. Inglés intermedio. Interés por el análisis financiero, riesgo, crédito y toma de decisiones basada en datos. Curiosidad y capacidad para aprender rápidamente. ¿Qué ofrecemos? Prestaciones de ley y superiores. Días personales (PTO). Horario de lunes a viernes. Beneficios adicionales. Un entorno de aprendizaje y crecimiento acelerado. Exposición a proyectos y decisiones que impactan directamente el negocio. Si te gusta trabajar con datos, cuestionar cómo se hacen las cosas y encontrar oportunidades donde otros solo ven números, queremos conocerte. #BravoCreeEnTi

Title: Technical Data Analyst

Description: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. Job Category Enterprise Technology & Infrastructure Job Details About Salesforce Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. We are seeking a detail-oriented, hands-on Technical Data Analyst to join our Master Data Management (MDM) Product Management team. This role is focused on core data profiling, trend analysis, data quality management, and first-line issue triage for our Informatica MDM and Data 360 platforms. Working closely with Data Stewards, Product Managers, Users, and Engineers, you will analyze data anomalies, identify root causes, monitor recurring trends, manage defects, and support UAT and key technical implementations. Key Responsibilities Data Profiling, Trends & Quality Management Hands-on Data Profiling: Write strong SQL queries to profile, inspect, and analyze incoming and existing data datasets across Informatica MDM and Data 360. Data Quality (DQ) Management: Monitor, measure, and flag data quality issues, exception patterns, and entity resolution mismatches to ensure platform data integrity. Data Trend Analysis: Identify and report on recurring data trends, systemic error patterns, and operational bottlenecks across team and system boundaries. First-Line Support & Defect Management First-Line Support: Act as the first point of contact for Data Stewards, Product Managers, and end users on operational data inquiries and platform issues. Root Cause & Defect Triage: Perform deep-dive data investigations to uncover root causes of issues and work directly with engineers to track, manage, and resolve defects. UAT Support & Technical Implementation UAT Execution Support: Assist with User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by validating data fixes, running test queries, and guiding stewards through test cases. Implementation Support: Support data validation and verification tasks during platform updates and technical feature rollouts. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications 3 years of hands-on experience in data analysis, data quality analysis, or technical support roles. Strong SQL & Data Profiling: Proven ability to write SQL scripts to analyze large datasets, diagnose data anomalies, and perform trend analysis. Data Quality Focus: Demonstrated understanding of Data Quality (DQ) management concepts, error tracking, and data profiling techniques. MDM & Data Tools: Exposure to or working knowledge of Informatica MDM and Data 360 platforms. Experience using issue/defect tracking tools to document and triage bugs with engineering teams. Strong analytical mindset and communication skills to work across team boundaries with stewards, users, and engineers. Preferred Qualifications Familiarity with data stewardship processes (golden record rules, entity resolution, deduplication, hierarchy mapping). Basic exposure to Python or (Tableau) for data quality reporting. Familiarity with AI tools and ability to spin up quick dashboards and reports Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. Title: Fraud and Abuse Head, Financial Services Mexico
Description: Description Lead the end-to-end fraud defense for a high-growth financial product in Mexico while directly shaping the balance between loss containment, customer experience, and approval rates. If you thrive on making high-stakes decisions with imperfect data and turning fraud signals into actionable rules, this is your opportunity to build and scale a fraud prevention function from the ground up. As the Fraud Prevention Head, you will design and execute the fraud prevention strategy across three critical stages: account onboarding, transaction monitoring, and post-transaction behavior analysis. To succeed, you must demonstrate a disciplined, evidence-based approach to rule design—combined with the sound judgment needed to operate under pressure and make critical decisions when information is incomplete. Success in this role is measured by fraud loss, detection and false positive rates and First Payment Default rate attributed to fraud. Experience in financial services fraud prevention, digital origination channels, knowledge of identity and validation vendors in Mexico, blacklists, device signals, and geolocation tools is a plus. Key job responsibilities You will manage the full ecosystem—including identity verification, biometrics, and document validation—while building and refining fraud rules and models grounded in evidence and data. You will own the loss taxonomy and lead the attribution process between fraud and credit risk in close partnership with the Credit Risk team, ensuring clear accountability and precise measurement. Your scope extends beyond external threats: you will lead the detection of internal fraud in coordination with business partners and the Payment Risk department and manage the disputes to ensure compliance with onboarding rules. You will serve as the primary liaison for incident reporting with Ops, AML, Legal, and Information Security teams, ensuring swift and coordinated responses. A day in the life You will monitor and tune the fraud prevention framework. This includes overseeing fraud alerts, following transaction anomaly dashboards, reviewing false positive rates to ensure legitimate customers are not being unnecessarily blocked, assessing detection rate trends against fraud loss targets and tracking First Payment Default cases attributed to fraud. You will analyze data to assess whether newly detected patterns warrant rule adjustments, model recalibrations, or escalation to the identity and biometrics vendors. You will join working sessions with Ops, AML, Legal, and BRP to coordinate active incident investigations, share intelligence on suspicious activity. Title: Manager, People Analytics
Description: The Workplace Engineering function sits at the intersection of traditional HR analytics and modern Product Engineering. We transform raw workforce data into a suite of "People Products" that drive high performance. We don’t just "report" on what happened; we engineer the tools and insights that determine what happens next. This new role will report directly to the Global Head of Workplace Engineering, and sits within our Data discipline inside of our People department. Experienced data professionals at Canonical live at the intersection of software, data, and the business. They don't just help surface analytic artifacts; they help transform them into a strategic asset that elevates decision making and innovation across our global operations (e.g., sales, marketing, engineering, and human resources). They balance technical precision with business pragmatism, designing and iterating on experiments, automations, and products that transform insights into valued outcomes. They shape tomorrow's AI/Data stack in open source, ensuring that Canonical remains at the forefront of data-driven excellence. Their curiosity is contagious and has an amplifying effect on data literacy and stewardship across the business teams they support. Location: This is a remote role based in the AMER or EMEA Region. The role entails Multi-Disciplinary Leadership: Lead and mentor a specialized squad of People Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and UX Designers. You aren't just managing analysts; you are leading a product squad. Product Ownership on People Science: Bridge the gap between "HR-speak" and "Dev-speak", ensuring engineers understand the human behavioral intent behind the code. Strategic Insight & Business Outcomes: Move beyond descriptive metrics (e.g., turnover rate) to predictive and prescriptive insights (e.g., predicting attrition risk based on "Time-Product" engagement data). Data Stewardship & Product Storytelling: Act as the "Translator-in-Chief". Take complex data models and turn them into compelling narratives. Lead the development of AI Agents that can surface insights to managers in real-time. Ensure the "People Data Stack" is secure, GDPR/privacy-compliant, and acts as a "Single Source of Truth" across all People related offerings, products and services. “Effectiveness at Work” Strategy: Identify opportunities to leverage “High Tech” solutions in our People offerings, and free up more time for “High Touch”, human involvement, thereby maximizing human value. What we are looking for in you Background in data science, mathematics, or engineering, skilled in advanced statistics, data wrangling/science, databases (SQL, etc.) or software engineering. Strength in coding/scripting languages (Python, R, JavaScript, etc.), software engineering, visualization (e.g. Superset, Tableau), and automation. Ability to translate business questions to key research objectives. Ability to identify the best methodology to execute research, synthesize and analyze findings. Proven ability to lead and drive others to execute against well planned roadmaps, with a strong mentor/coaching mindset. Willingness to examine the status quo and be resilient in the face of challenges. Ambition to build tomorrow's AI/Data stack in open source. An exceptional academic track record from high school and university. Business level written and spoken English. Sincere personal motivation aligned with our mission. International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long. In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being: Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity. Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence. Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable. Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character. Nice-to-have skills Experience with dbt (Data Build Tool), Airbyte, Ranger, Superset, Temporal, or Trino Basic understanding of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes Agentic Engineering Product management User experience and design What we offer colleagues We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We assess performance and revisit compensation twice annually to ensure we recognize outstanding colleagues. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year Bi-annual compensation review Company recognition rewards 40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods Maternity and paternity leave Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing. Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Title: 0004 Head of Revenue Management & PRGM – E-commerce
Description: Sr Revenue Management – E-commerce Requisitos: Escolaridad Licenciatura concluida en Economía, Finanzas, Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Actuaría, Administración o áreas afines. Maestría deseable. Años y área de experiencia Más de 5 años de experiencia en Revenue Management, PRGM, Pricing, Commercial Strategy o Growth, incluyendo experiencia liderando equipos o proyectos de alta complejidad. Es indispensable haber tenido responsabilidad directa sobre la estrategia de PRGM de un e-commerce, marketplace o aplicación DTC. Se valorará experiencia en empresas como Rappi, Uber Eats, PedidosYa, DiDi Food, Walmart.com, Amazon, Mercado Libre o modelos de negocio comparables. No buscamos un perfil enfocado únicamente en reporting, finanzas o ejecución de promociones, sino experiencia comprobable tomando decisiones de precio, volumen, mix, descuentos y rentabilidad. Idioma Ingles intermedio - avanzado Conocimientos técnicos Dominio avanzado de PRGM, arquitectura de precios y administración de revenue. Experiencia estimando elasticidad y sensibilidad de demanda, incluyendo elasticidades cruzadas, canibalización y sustitución entre SKUs. Capacidad para optimizar conjuntamente precio y cantidad —P × Q—, buscando maximizar Net Revenue y margen de contribución, no únicamente GMV o volumen. Conocimiento práctico de modelos de optimización, simulación de escenarios, forecasting y metodologías de experimentación. Experiencia diseñando descuentos progresivos, price ladders, promociones personalizadas y modelos de Smart Discounts. Dominio avanzado de P&L, presupuestos promocionales y evaluación de Trade Spend. Manejo de SQL y herramientas de visualización como Power BI, Tableau o Looker. Conocimiento de Python o R deseable. Competencias : Pensamiento analítico, estratégico y comercial. Capacidad para transformar análisis y modelos matemáticos en decisiones comerciales ejecutables. Influencia y liderazgo transversal con equipos de Finanzas, Marketing, Operaciones, Data Science, Producto y Tecnología. Capacidad para cuestionar supuestos, estructurar problemas ambiguos y priorizar oportunidades por impacto financiero. Orientación a resultados, ownership y disciplina de ejecución. Lugar de trabajo Miguel Hidalgo, CDMX, México. Horario 8 a 6 pm Propósito y actividades del puesto: Buscamos un líder de Revenue Management con experiencia real en PRGM para definir y ejecutar la estrategia de precios, promociones y descuentos de nuestro canal DTC. La posición será responsable de maximizar Net Revenue y margen de contribución mediante la optimización conjunta de precio, volumen, mix y frecuencia de compra. El rol deberá combinar visión comercial, profundidad financiera y conocimiento cuantitativo para construir decisiones de pricing basadas en elasticidad, comportamiento histórico del consumidor y modelos de optimización. Responsabilidades principales: Estrategia de Revenue Management y PRGM: Diseñar la arquitectura de precios por SKU, categoría, ocasión y segmento de consumidor. Definir price ladders, escalones de precio y esquemas de descuento progresivo que incentiven compras incrementales sin destruir margen. Elasticidad y optimización: Estimar curvas de demanda y elasticidades de precio para anticipar el impacto de cambios de precio y promociones. Desarrollar simulaciones y modelos de optimización de P × Q bajo restricciones de margen, presupuesto, inventario y objetivos comerciales. Promociones y Smart Discounts: Diseñar promociones segmentadas y modelos de descuentos personalizados con apoyo de Data Science. Evaluar incrementalidad, canibalización, ROI promocional y efectividad del gasto comercial mediante pruebas A/B y metodologías de test-and-learn. Análisis financiero y performance: Administrar el presupuesto de descuentos y overprice. Title: WFM Central - Real Time Analyst

We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities. Overview 📍 Remote Global - Non U.S. We are seeking a WFM Central - Real Time Analyst to serve as the central governance layer for live operations across multiple Lines of Business (LoB). This is not a traditional monitoring role; it is designed for a high-caliber, forensic operator who functions as an operational architect. You will be a trusted partner to operational leadership, responsible for continuing to evolve our operations to a standardized, and fiscally sound control model. The ideal candidate possesses the technical "know-how" of a forensic analyst and the communication prowess of a business consultant, capable of telling a compelling story through data to stakeholders ranging from Team Leads to Directors. You will be the owner of all aspects of the support queues and ensure we are meeting our customers where they need us. Responsibilities Stakeholder Storytelling: Distill complex, "noisy" operational signals into high-impact narratives. You must be able to share in-depth observations and supporting data that tell a clear story to stakeholders, at all levels of leadership, on exactly what actions must be taken. Business-Level Analysis: Go beyond the "what" and the "why" to analyze long-term business trends. Evaluate the financial efficiency of SLA safeguarding and the fiscal impact of current staffing vs. demand density. Operational Control & Forensic Auditing: Serve as the authoritative "voice of reason" during incidents. Conduct forensic audits of agent behaviors such as "On Hold" abuse or status irregularities to ensure hidden capacity drains are eliminated. Centralized Core Governance: Enact queue management playbooks for real-time levers across multiple LoBs, ensuring aggressive SLAs are preserved through structured accountability. Strategic Planning & Optimization: Partner with WFM to create a concise feedback loop for continued improvement in planning and scheduling. Qualifications Exceptional Communication: Proven ability to translate complex data into a clear jargon-free business story. You must be comfortable presenting actionable insights to senior leadership under high-pressure conditions. Advanced Forensic Analysis: Expert proficiency in Google Sheets is required, familiarity with Metabase preferred. You must be able to build complex, automated tracking tools and forensic audits from scratch. Not just for basic queue health, but also analyzing business data that influences our operations. Strategic Judgment: Demonstrated experience making high-judgment decisions that impact the entire business, particularly in environments with aggressive SLAs and fluctuating volume patterns. Operational Architecture: Take ownership in documenting best practices into governed frameworks and playbooks. Resilient Mindset: Comfortable operating autonomously in a 24/7 environment, with the flexibility to adapt to operational needs as part of a high-impact, interdependent team. Systems Fluency: Familiarity with Amazon Connect, Zendesk Omnichannel routing, and Assembled WFM is highly preferred. What Success Looks Like Operational anomalies are quickly investigated, with root causes clearly identified and communicated, reducing repeat issues and leadership uncertainty You evolve queue management processes from reactive to a documented, standardized, and predictive operating model. Champion of the team’s brand with Operational Leadership. You are looked to as the primary source of truth, relying on your data-driven stories to make critical staffing and operational decisions. Live queues remain stable, governed, and resilient across all supported lines of business, even during unexpected spikes, outages, or incidents Stakeholders receive timely, clear updates during incidents that explain impact, cause, and corrective actions in a concise and actionable manner. Title: Manager, Fraud Attack Response & Insights - LAC
Industries: Financial Services, IT Services and IT Consulting, and Technology, Information and Internet
Description: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title And Summary Manager, Fraud Attack Response & Insights - LAC Who is Mastercard? Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all. Overview The Fraud Attack Response & Insights team is Mastercard’s integrated fraud attack response, intelligence, and card security control functions, overseeing real-time incident response, fraud insights generation, and card/application security standards. The Manager, Fraud Attack Response & Insights-LAC is responsible for analyzing fraud attacks impacting Mastercard customers across the region and translating those incidents into actionable intelligence, remediation recommendations, and risk mitigation opportunities. The role focuses on fraud affecting account opening, payment cards, and account-to-account transactions. Working closely with customers, regional stakeholders, product teams, and fraud response leaders, the Manager helps identify emerging attack patterns, assess control effectiveness, and develop recommendations that strengthen Mastercard's fraud defenses. This is a role focused on securing the transactions Mastercard enables and the stakeholders in those transactions (e.g., issuers, acquirers, merchants). This is not a corporate or information security function. Role Participate in high-impact fraud TRTs and customer response activities. Support fraud attack investigations, analysis, and incident response coordination. Develop post-incident retrospectives and contribute to systemic remediation recommendations. Analyze fraud attacks, emerging threats, and customer fraud events to identify common attack vectors, vulnerabilities, and control gaps. Produce fraud intelligence reports, attack assessments, and executive-ready summaries. Partner with regional stakeholders to collect market intelligence and identify emerging fraud trends. Support development and maintenance of the fraud attack registry and associated threat intelligence repositories. Identify opportunities for network controls, standards enhancements, and product improvements based on fraud attack learnings. Collaborate with Security Solutions product teams, Standards teams, and regional market teams to evaluate mitigation options. Contribute to fraud governance processes, risk prioritization activities, and escalation discussions. Support the translation of fraud attack insights into card security standards, application security requirements, and network controls. Build and maintain strong relationships with fraud leaders at customers, regional teams, and industry partners. All About You Experience in payment fraud, fraud operations, fraud intelligence, or fraud risk management. Strong understanding of payment card fraud, account opening fraud, account-to-account fraud, and emerging payment threats. Experience conducting fraud investigations, attack analysis, or incident response activities. Ability to identify patterns across disparate data sources and develop actionable insights. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex findings to senior audiences. Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Experience working across functions, regions, and cultures. Knowledge of payment ecosystems, card security controls, authentication technologies, and fraud mitigation techniques. Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. Demonstrated curiosity, continuous learning mindset, and passion for protecting the payments ecosystem. Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in an exciting, fast-growing business. The successful candidate will develop and execute lifecycle and outbound strategies (Push, Email, WhatsApp) that move customers through the funnel, from acquisition and first purchase to repeat purchase, Prime adoption and retention. They will act as the bridge between marketing channel owners and category teams, translating category needs into campaigns and programs and bringing company-wide priorities to category teams. They will also own the team's BI and reporting mechanisms, standardizing the metrics category teams use in their weekly, monthly and quarterly business reviews. The ideal candidate has strong analytical and SQL skills, a test-and-learn mindset, and the ability to simplify and scale through automation and AI. They communicate clearly across functions and levels, thrive with ambiguity and changing priorities, and enjoy a highly entrepreneurial environment. We are seeking someone with a proven track record in channel management, experimentation and project management. Key job responsibilities Lead category lifecycle strategy: analyze each category's customer funnel (active customers, new customer acquisition, repeat purchase, Prime adoption), present insights to category stakeholders, and plan and launch category-specific lifecycle initiatives. Act as the point of contact for category-specific and company-wide lifecycle and Prime initiatives, coordinating execution with lifecycle and Prime teams. Own category outbound marketing (Push, Email, WhatsApp): create campaigns for company priorities and major and seasonal events, ensure campaigns hit goals, and optimize performance across categories. Drive experimentation across free outbound channels and WhatsApp, including customer acquisition and Prime tests. Document learnings and scale what works. Own BI and reporting for the Category Marketing team: standardize weekly, monthly and quarterly metrics for category business reviews, with category-level drill-downs and visibility for all teams. Deliver deep dives on campaign and funnel performance, with clear recommendations to category and marketing teams. Increase category team adoption of lifecycle self-service tools, including engagement and gamification programs. Lead efficiencies through AI and automation: semi-automated campaigns, automated reports and faster asset creation. Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Lifecycle, Prime, Category Management, Vendor Management and BI teams. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives. Mentorship & Career Growth Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. Title: Sustainability data advisor, fixed-term (CDMX)
Description: About Watershed Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team. We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us! The role We are looking for a customer-focused and analytically-minded person to join the Sustainability Data Advisory team in our Mexico City office on a fixed-term basis, starting in December 2026. This is a chance to join a core team at a growth-stage startup that works with the world's top companies to speed up their sustainability programs. You'll work directly with customers as a trusted advisor, leading measurement sessions and delivering advisory services that unlock the full value of our platform. You'll help customers get clear, reliable insight into their sustainability impact and reach their sustainability goals. You will: Advise sustainability teams at many of the world's top companies. You'll work directly with customers on how to measure actionable carbon and non-carbon footprints to reach sustainability goals and enable real reductions. The work ranges from scoping new measurements to in-depth methodology comparisons between footprints. Deliver services that speed up customer success. You'll help customers set up their measurements to meet sustainability goals, act as a trusted partner in emissions verifications, and give specialized advice to improve their data and methodologies. You'll make sure customers get the most out of Watershed's platform, faster and more effectively than they could on their own. Collaborate with science, engineering and product teams to build new measurement solutions and expand Watershed's sustainability intelligence layer. You might be a fit if you: Have 2–4 years of experience in a consulting, solutions-engineering or other customer-facing role. You are excited to work directly with customers to help them set the foundation for world-class sustainability programs. Have experience in sustainability-related fields, greenhouse gas accounting and/or ESG reporting. Are an excellent verbal and written communicator. You can explain complex topics to technical and non-technical audiences. Learn quickly and work well in ambiguity. You are organized, systematic and efficient, and you thrive in a high-volume environment. Think clearly about complex problems and are comfortable using and speaking to data. You are meticulous and detail-obsessed. Are passionate about solving climate change and excited to help do so at a fast-paced startup. Have strong English proficiency. Fixed-term details Starts in December 2026. Minimum commitment of 4 months, with a possible extension of up to 3 more months. Fixed-term employees receive compensation and benefits similar to full-time Watershed employees, including daily lunch delivered in the Watershed office. This role requires working in person in our Mexico City office 4 days per week. Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles) Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so. What’s the interview process like? It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process. What if I need accommodations for my interview? At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. Description: You may know McCormick as a leader in herbs, spices, seasonings, and condiments – and we’re only getting started. At McCormick, we’re always looking for new people to bring their unique flavor to our team. McCormick employees – all 14,000 of us across the world – are what makes this company a great place to work. We are looking to hire a Supply Chain Analyst in a Hybrid (60/40) capacity for our site in Interlomas Mexico City . This is 3 days in the office and 2 days remote. Please submit your CV in English. What We Bring To The Table The best people deserve the best rewards. In addition to the benefits, you’d expect from a global leader (health insurance, paid time off, etc.) we also offer: Competitive compensation Career growth opportunities Flexibility and Support for Diverse Life Stages and Choices We prioritize our communities and the planet we share Wellbeing programs including Physical, Mental and Financial wellness Position Overview The Supply Chain Analyst II role will be heavily focused on data extraction & analysis supporting all aspects of the End to End Planning team in delivering key KPIs in the areas of service, working capital, and waste/IAR.
